item.text:
<linkedin_post>DoorDash says it has received “several hundred” orders in total from third-party AI agents. For comparison, the company reported an average of 3 million deliveries a day in 2025.

That gap suggests agent-based ordering is still small for DoorDash, though the figures cover different periods and are not directly comparable. CEO Tony Xu said customers continue to order predominantly through the DoorDash app.

DoorDash is exploring the channel while building its own ordering tools, including a chatbot that accepts prompts and photos. Xu also raised the possibility of advertising within third-party agents.

Access remains an open question for companies building those agents. Amazon has blocked personal agents, while Walmart has welcomed them. Whether an agent can place an order may depend as much on the retailer’s policies as on the technology itself.</linkedin_post>
